name: AI Task Export
desc: Turn handwritten to-dos into tasks with AI. Pick your AI (Claude or OpenAI) and your task app (Amazing Marvin, Todoist or TickTick) once in Settings. From the sidebar, export every to-do AI finds on this page, chosen pages, or the whole note, or only from headings you mark with the diagonal-line style. Or lasso specific items and tap Export Tasks: everything you select becomes a task and nothing else is sent, ideal for adding one item without re-sending a page. Uses your own API keys, stored only on this device (MyStyle/SnMarvin/settings.note) or in a key file you place in MyStyle. Note images and text go only to the AI you select (api.anthropic.com or api.openai.com); task titles and notes go only to your task app (serv.amazingmarvin.com, api.todoist.com or api.ticktick.com). Nothing else leaves the device. For setup and instructions, tap the ⚙ settings button, then Instructions. Support: github.com/ddpedersen/SuperNote/issues.
author: Derek Pedersen
